# Tetelestai

> Tetelestai (Tetelestai Soluções em Tecnologia Ltda., CNPJ 58.138.258/0001-39) is a small technology studio in Brasília, Brazil. It builds websites and landing pages for small businesses, publishes iOS apps, sells a guide for tech professionals applying to international jobs, and runs on-demand AI training. Contact is through WhatsApp (+55 61 98471-1930) or contato@tetelestai.tech.

## Key facts

- Landing page: R$ 697 (or 2 × R$ 348.50). One page with up to 5 sections, mobile version, WhatsApp button, basic SEO and one round of revisions. Live in up to 5 business days after the client sends texts and photos. Domain and hosting are billed separately.
- Multi-page websites, systems and automations are quoted in writing after a conversation.
- Founders: Carlos Viegas (Co-Founder & CTO) and Gabriela Rosa (Co-Founder & CEO).
- Service is delivered online, in Portuguese or English, to clients in Brasília and other cities.
- The career guide and AI training do not guarantee interviews, hiring, salaries or visas, and do not include immigration legal advice.

## Pages (Portuguese)

- [Home](https://tetelestai.tech/): websites and landing pages for small businesses in Brasília
- [Criação de sites](https://tetelestai.tech/criacao-de-sites/): multi-page business websites, quoted per project
- [Criação de landing pages](https://tetelestai.tech/criacao-de-landing-pages/): the R$ 697 landing page offer
- [Projetos](https://tetelestai.tech/projetos/): client websites and the De Rolê and Tempo de Recarga iOS apps
- [Infinity Car Studio](https://tetelestai.tech/projetos/infinity-car-studio/): car detailing website case study
- [Bolachinhas da Vovó Juju](https://tetelestai.tech/projetos/bolachinhas-da-vovo-juju/): artisan food landing page case study
- [Carreira internacional em TI](https://tetelestai.tech/carreira-internacional/): the Essencial guide (R$ 47): English CV, LinkedIn and application tracking
- [Capacitação em IA](https://tetelestai.tech/capacitacao-em-ia/): on-demand AI training for teams and professionals
